name: SmartIcons Glyph
about: SmartIcons Glyph is a free, open-source icon set with 799 icons designed by SmartIcons. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY SA 4.0.

faqs.q: Are SmartIcons Glyph free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 799 SmartIcons Glyph are open source under the CC BY SA 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY SA 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use SmartIcons Glyph in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many SmartIcons Glyph are there?
faqs.a: There are 799 icons in the SmartIcons Glyph set, designed by SmartIcons. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of SmartIcons Glyph?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are SmartIcons Glyph available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
